name: ZG: Zombie Garden Defense
summary:
PLANT. SHOOT. SURVIVE.

ZG is a VR plant defense game against zombie waves.
But this time… you fight too.


🌱 Strategic Plant Defense

Grow powerful plants and combine different abilities to stop massive zombie waves.
